name: Tutorial
description: A young orphan, an old cargo train, and a coal mine. Learn the trade.

intro.text:
You never knew your parents. The coal city took you in, and the railway gave you something to do.
Every morning, the same run: load coal at the mine, carry it to the foundry, and come back before dark.
An old locomotive, a tender and a few wagons are all you own.
But the foundry is running low on iron, and somebody has to do something about it.
